data.name: Be Damned!
data.detailed_description:
"Be Damned!" elevates the ARPG genre, offering a unique 6-player co-op experience set in a riveting medieval backdrop. Players engage in an innovative spell-casting system, executing powerful magic and melee attacks against demonic adversaries. For solo adventurers, companions ensure the journey is never lonely, contributing to the strategic depth of battles. The game introduces a superior wave system, seamlessly integrating escalating challenges within the narrative, ensuring each skirmish advances the story. With its blend of companionship, strategic combat, and a deeply immersive story, "Be Damned" is an epic saga of magic, valor, and survival against all odds.

  • Experience quests collectively as all players share the same objectives in real-time, ensuring a cohesive and synchronized multiplayer adventure.

  • Even when playing solo, you're never alone. Companions with unique abilities join you, enhancing strategies and gameplay dynamics.

  • Unlock and master a diverse arsenal of weapon skills and magic spells, each tailored to enhance your strategic options and combat effectiveness in the heat of battle.

data.short_description: “Be Damned!” is a dark medieval ARPG where players control the Beholder and his five resurrected familiars; ancient wizards uniting to halt the apocalypse. Featuring 6-player co-op, deep spellcasting, fluid melee-magic combat, a wave-based story, and a unified quest system.
